readme:
Your Tripinly data

This archive holds a copy of the data connected to your Tripinly account, created on {createdAt} (UTC).

profile.json: your profile, sign-in methods, settings, devices and paid features.
consents.json: the terms and privacy notices you accepted or withdrew, with dates.
trips.json: the trips you own or edit, with their days and places.
comments.json: the comments you wrote.
likes.json: what you liked.
notifications.json: the notifications you received.
blocks.json: the people you blocked.
reports.json: the reports you filed.
photos/: the photos you uploaded, without location or camera data.

Dates and times are in UTC (ISO 8601). Ids let you match entries across files.
